blocks.raw: <Tip>**Circulation Anchor**: Think in hierarchy — Primary (widest, wayfinding spine), Secondary (distribution), Service (back-of-house). Corridor widths follow PD 1096 and occupancy, not a single universal number. Dead-ends are controlled by RA 9514 IRR; always check the specific occupancy and sprinkler condition, not just a memorized value.</Tip>
